title: Questions 131-134 refer to the following memo.
passage_1:
To: All Shift Supervisors
From: Gregor Vance
Date: June 6
Subject: Revised Procedure

At Halloway Print Works, the safety of our production teams and visitors is our main concern. ------- (131) The compulsory safety training required before handling powered machinery on the factory floor will be lengthened. ------- (132), this training is two hours long. But effective June 20, it will run for four hours. I hope this will better equip our operators for the demands of ------- (133) a press and lower the chance of injuries.

The revised weekly training schedule ------- (134) in the staff cafeteria on Monday, June 16. Thank you.
